description: Building-wide wall panel takeoff totals (Tilt or Precast), computed by AME_Summary
title: WallSummary

Gross_Vol_CY.description: Total gross concrete volume of all wall panels (excluding insulation), CY

Net_Vol_CY.description: Total net concrete volume of all wall panels (excluding insulation and openings), CY

Gross_Area_ft2.description: Total gross wall panel area, sqft

Net_Area_ft2.description: Total net wall panel area (excluding openings), sqft

Reinf_lbs.description: Total wall panel reinforcement weight, lbs (0 for Precast)

Groups.description: Panels grouped by dock/non-dock, thickness and insulation, ordered dock first then by descending thickness
